import html # Template for rendering a blog post; placeholders: {title}, {body} BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user-generated blog post safely. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for display in a web page. Raises ------ ValueError If either title or body is empty after stripping whitespace. """ if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(body, str): raise TypeError("Title and body must be strings") # Strip leading/trailing whitespace title = title.strip() body = body.strip() if not title: raise ValueError("Title cannot be empty") if not body: raise ValueError("Body cannot be empty") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Use the provided format template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
